notes:
What's new in 0.9.244 (beta)
- SMART knows what it wrote: after a setup change SMART reads back the values it wrote, and tyre pressure advice respects the car's pressure limits.
- Lap-1 highlights: the first-lap pack keeps the opening-corner contacts and your passes.
- Assetto Corsa car names: Kunos cars without a name in GOAT's list no longer show a "Ks" prefix; six more cars named.
- Reference list in Spanish: every label in the reference lap dropdown is translated.
- Sim tabs: clicking the sim tab you are already on keeps you on the session you are viewing.
- Setup changes, out loud: SMART reads every setup change out loud and waits for your yes before saving it, and never changes something it said can't be adjusted.
- Overlay quick starts (Basic, Racer, Pro): closing the telemetry overlay closes every overlay it opened. "Update this set" tells you why when it can't save, and after a quick start you can "Save as a new set".
- Monza track map: lines up with the satellite view, and the reference lap draws its own line.
- Radar on the grid: the starting grid shows two-wide rows, left and right, instead of cars stacked in the middle.
- Smoother overlay: steadier updates on busy grids.
